title: Push Band Set Peak Velocity Leaderboard
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pushband:set peak_velocity_m_s=*
| stats sum(peak_velocity_m_s) as total_value, avg(peak_velocity_m_s) as avg_value by exercise_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks exercise values by total and average peak velocity across Push Band set events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `peak_velocity_m_s` values for each Push Band set event and review total and average peak velocity by exercise.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total peak velocity.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which exercise shows the biggest peak velocity numbers in your Push Band set data.
